name: Futari Gurashi no Jijou ~Mei no Nichijou Hen~
original_name: ふたりぐらしの事情 ～芽衣の日常編～
source:
Six months have passed since their incestuous affair began.
As uncle and niece, as lovers, they are intimately connected.
Little by little, day by day, their love progresses.
Life together has still only just begun. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE108136.html]DLsite English[/url]]
